summary: First iteration testing of NeuroHistory PK. Ran 25 pytest cases against production preview URL covering auth (admin/doctor/register/pending), public search, patients CRUD with Dyken auto-compute, edit-request workflow, audit trail (RBAC), research query + CSV export, file upload/download (auth required), and admin endpoints (list/verify/suspend/reactivate/stats). All 25 backend tests PASS. Frontend: landing loads with hero + public doctor search (Karachi returns Ayesha), doctor login redirects to /doctor and shows tabs My Patients/All Patients/Edit Requests/Research with counts, patient detail navigable, PatientWizard renders with sticky Dyken score badge (0/5) and step-0 form. Admin login shows 5 stat cards (Pending 1, Verified 5, Suspended 0, Patient Records 4, Pending Edit Reqs 0), Doctors table with Verify/Suspend actions. Research tab returns 4 matches aggregated by province with Export CSV button.
critical_code_review_comments: seed_patients uses count>0 short-circuit; test-created records can prevent re-seeding if DB is partially wiped — acceptable for now.
download_file uses rec.get('content_type', ct) — good fallback. HTTP 401 for unauth verified via test.
CORS uses allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True. Works in practice but browsers may reject wildcard+credentials on strict clients; consider explicit origin list for hardening.
auth.py: bcrypt hash format $2b verified via successful bcrypt.checkpw on seeded users.
seed_data_creation: Created a TEST doctor via register endpoint and several TEST_* patient records via API; audit + edit-request lifecycle exercised. No manual cleanup performed (records are prefixed TEST_ for identification).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py uses pytest-xdist auto-parallel; 25 tests run in ~7s. pytest.pid_ayesha is a module-attr trick to share created patient id between tests; ordering relies on the natural class order (Patients before EditRequests before Audit). All flows are green. UI counters may lag ~1-2s post-login; use wait_for_timeout(2000) before asserting counts.
